text:
Ellen - Product: @channel: heads-up: new Region-Binding Enforcement for Private clusters goes into effect 2026-09-01. Short summary: every Private/VPC cluster must declare a single primary region for data residency. Mixed-region clusters must pick a canonical region or apply for an exception. See action items below.

Marco - Eng-SRE: question: how strict is enforcement? Will clusters be blocked from provisioning?

Ellen - Product: enforcement is phased: provisioning checks will require a region at create time immediately; enforcement for existing clusters will be advisory for 60 days, then advisory+alerts for 30 days, then enforcement (failed validation prevents certain cross-region ops) after 2026-11-01.

Priya - Legal: this affects contract language and SOC/FedRAMP attestations. We'll prepare a short addendum and a customer notification template.

Rita - CS: need a migration checklist for accounts with replicated storage. Also want an outbound email template and a webinar.

Jon - Sales: flagging: field needs a lead time for quoting legal customers. We'll coordinate with Priya.

infra-bot: feature flag "private.region_binding_v1" enabled in staging at 2026-07-05T08:12Z.

Ellen - Product: Action list:
- Eng-SRE (Marco): infra checks + validation UI + telemetry alerts -> due 2026-08-01
- Legal (Priya): addendum + customer notice template -> due 2026-07-20
- CS (Rita): migration checklist + webinar slides -> due 2026-07-25
- Sales (Jon): quote language + field FAQ -> due 2026-07-22

Marco - Eng-SRE: ack, will open a repo and invite owners.

Ellen - Product: we'll discuss details in the Private sync on Friday 09:00 PT. DM me if you need an exception for a high-touch customer. Thanks everyone.
